content.short: Rabby Wallet is a wallet for Ethereum and all EVM chains.
content.description: Rabby Wallet provides a smooth multi-chain Web3 experience by automatically switching to the chain required by the Web3 dApp you visit. A built-in security rule engine analyzes transactions for potential errors and risks before you sign, helping you confirm safety and intent. As you prepare a transaction, Rabby Wallet displays an estimated balance change and the expected impact on your funds, so you can review details and approve with confidence.
content.meta: Rabby Wallet is a Web3 wallet with multi-chain auto-switching based on the dApp you visit. Discover Rabby Wallet and other Web3 Wallets on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
